red__fitscube_crop.pro


Routines

top source red::fitscube_crop

SST pipeline

red::fitscube_crop, infile [, /centered] [, iscan=integer] [, istokes=integer] [, ituning=integer] [, /nospectral] [, outfile=string] [, /overwrite] [, roi=array] [, size=integer or array] [, xc=integer] [, yc=integer]

Crop a fitscube while maintaining meta data.

Parameters

infile in type=string

The name of the file containing the fitscube to be cropped.

Keywords

centered in optional type=boolean

Set this to get a centered FOV. Specify the size with the size keyword or

iscan in optional type=integer

Select image to display in xroi GUI by setting ituning, istokes, and/or iscan. Indices not specified signals a dimension to sum over.

istokes in optional type=integer

Select image to display in xroi GUI by setting ituning, istokes, and/or iscan. Indices not specified signals a dimension to sum over.

ituning in optional type=integer

Select image to display in xroi GUI by setting ituning, istokes, and/or iscan. Indices not specified signals a dimension to sum over.

nospectral in optional type=boolean

If set, don't make any spectral, "flipped" data cubes.

outfile in optional type=string default=Based on infile

The name of the file in which to store the cropped cube.

overwrite in optional type=boolean

Set this to overwrite older files.

roi in out optional type=array

Give the ROI corner coordinates [llx,urx,lly,ury] to bypass interactive FOV selection. If the FOV is selected interactively and/or specified with the size and centered keywords the roi is returned in this keyword.

size in optional type=integer or array

Set this to a FOV size to only select center of FOV interactively. If an array, it is interpreted as sx=size[0], sy=size[1]. If a single integer, sx=sy=size.

xc in out optional type=integer

X pixel coordinate of center of FOV.

yc in out optional type=integer

Y pixel coordinate of center of FOV.

Author information

Author:

Mats Löfdahl, Institute for Solar Physics
